name: dsh-memory-graph
author: ISKING <admin@isking.cc>
description: Long-term associative memory for DeepSeek Harness: a local plain-text vault of raw episodes, typed memory cards and entity pages, configured from 设置 → 记忆图谱, and a Memory tab inside a conversation that draws what that session remembered. No build step; the only dependency is the harness's own schema library, used for the Settings page.

scripts.test: node test/smoke.mjs && node test/schema.mjs && node test/client.mjs && node test/capture.mjs && node test/tools.mjs && node test/extract.mjs && node test/graphdata.mjs && node test/page.mjs && node test/distillapi.mjs && node test/auto.mjs && node eval/run.mjs
